claims.text: The declared parser accepts only an exact Q: prefix followed by two unsigned integers separated by a literal plus sign, with no spaces or trailing text and returns0 otherwise. Fixed tasks1+2,2+3,3+4,4+5 have targets3,5,7,9 and an unchanged integer-equality scorer. Exact Q:a+b template scores4/4; Question: a+b scores0/4. Prefix normalization maps Question: to Q: and both templates score4/4. These literal templates are manipulated stimuli. This finite parser experiment does not measure LLM sensitivity; changing the scorer would add a confound.
